description: Neuro Vitals is a focused solo/private team building an AI-powered astronaut health monitoring and cognitive telemetry system for deep-space missions. Combining real NASA physiological datasets with next-gen neural interface concepts, we aim to detect fatigue, stress, and medical anomalies early during long-duration spaceflight. (Note: Not currently open to public join requests.)
summary: Neuro Vitals is an autonomous deep-space astronaut health telemetry and non-invasive Brain-Computer Interface (BCI) clinical decision-support console grounded in NASA-STD-3001 and NASA Open Science Data Repository (OSDR) benchmarks. During exploration missions to the Moon and Mars, one-way communication delays of up to 22 minutes prevent real-time medical guidance from Earth flight surgeons. Neuro Vitals solves this by acting as an onboard autonomous flight-surgeon console with an Apple vision-OS-inspired clinical interface. It streams 60fps 3-channel Lead II ECG, Prefrontal BCI, and Side stream Capnography waveforms alongside a 6-Node Anatomical Diagnostic Scanner covering neuro-ocular pressure (SANS/OCT), pulmonary gas exchange, cardiovascular strain, radiation dosimetry, and bone mineral density. When an emergency such as an EVA CO2 washout occurs, hands-free sensorimotor-rhythm (SMR) BCI decoding enables astronauts to trigger immediate suit LiOH purges without manual input.

What It Does & How It Works: Beyond Low Earth Orbit, communication latency with Earth (14–22 minutes one-way) eliminates real-time ground medical intervention. Neuro Vitals functions as an autonomous onboard clinical telemetry and Brain-Computer Interface (BCI) command system designed to keep crews safe during deep-space transit and extravehicular activities (EVAs).

Core Capabilities:

  • 6-Node Anatomical Diagnostic Scanner: Interactive biometric body map covering BCI/fNIRS Cortex, Spaceflight Associated Neuro-ocular Syndrome (SANS/OCT), Pulmonary Gas Exchange (pCO2/SpO2), Cardiovascular Function, Radiation Dosimetry, and Femoral Bone Mineral Density (BMD), complete with pathophysiology explanations and step-by-step self-exam checklists.
  • Real-Time 3-Channel Clinical Oscilloscope: Renders live 60fps Lead II ECG, Prefrontal BCI (Fp1–Fp2 µV), and Sidestream Capnography (ETCO2) waveforms paired with Theta/Alpha/Beta/rSO2 spectral readouts.
  • Autonomous Triage & Hands-Free BCI Command Decoder: Evaluates multi-sensor physiological thresholds locally against NASA-STD-3001 limits and allows hands-occupied or incapacitated astronauts to trigger critical countermeasures (such as an EVA Suit O2 LiOH Purge) via non-invasive motor-imagery BCI.
  • Multi-Scenario Mission Simulator & Countermeasure Tracker: Includes live clinical stress profiles (Nominal Transit, EVA CO2 Washout & Hypoxia, G4 Solar Particle Storm, SANS & Circadian Desynchrony) and daily countermeasure compliance tracking.

Tools, Languages & Development: Built as a high-performance, zero-dependency single-page clinical web application using HTML5 Canvas API, CSS3 glassmorphic UI architecture, and Vanilla ES6+ JavaScript, hosted publicly on GitHub Pages.
